title: First confirmed ascent of Mount Everest
summary: Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary reached the summit of the world's highest mountain.
why: Reached the roof of the world.

notes.problem: Place: Everest 'marks part of the China-Nepal border at its summit'; climb was from the Nepalese side, summit is not in Nepal alone.
Source: 'the first confirmed to have succeeded'; the 1924 Mallory-Irvine question keeps 'first' open.

superlativeSource: the first confirmed to have succeeded
